title: Foundation design for seismic overturning.
officialText: Where foundations are proportioned using the load combinations of Sections 1605.2 or 1605.3.1 and the computation of seismic overturning effects is by equivalent lateral force or modal analysis, the proportioning shall be in accordance with Section 12.13.4 of ASCE 7-10.
